Title: Classic network security groups available in portal

Body.Content:
Classic network security groups (NSGs) can now be managed via the Azure portal. Through the portal, you can now:
  • Manage (view, edit, and delete) existing NSGs.
  • Manage (view, edit, and delete) NSGs associated with subnets and virtual machines.
  • Create new NSGs and associate them with subnets and virtual machines.
Note  These capabilities are available only via the Azure portal.
